LES ESSENCES DE NEW YORK ✳ A CITY OF A THOUSAND SCENTS ✳ SPRING 2027
A collection inspired by New York

Four scents. One city.
A thousand memories.

Spring is experienced differently in every neighborhood: a flower-lined brownstone, a quiet Greenwich Village morning, rain on Fifth Avenue, or cedar along the river. These six placements turn everyday urban encounters into sensory stories.

01 / The collectionFour olfactory portraits

The city's four moods.

Each scent has a distinct palette and atmosphere, united by fine-art photography, botanical details, and an engraved New York identity.

Magnolia, peony and white musk. Soft florals among brownstones and spring blossoms.

03 / Art directionCampaign system

Made for the city.

Every original image was conceived independently of its mockup, so the artwork can retain its resolution and identity across placements. The mockups demonstrate how each visual could live in New York rather than serving as the original advertisement.

I / Consistency

One visual language

Engraved botanical imagery, elegant serif typography, tactile print textures, restrained ornament and a shared campaign signature unite the six pieces.

II / Context

Site-specific storytelling

Each location carries part of the scent’s story: flower cart, boutique, hotel, subway, brownstone wall and neighborhood newsstand.

III / Scale

Artwork before mockup

Horizontal, vertical and panoramic images respond to different installation formats. Source dimensions are documented for each piece above.

The pixel sizes above describe the original supplied files, not finalized physical print measurements. Before real-world production, confirm exact vendor dimensions, bleed, color mode and effective resolution. All placements shown are conceptual campaign mockups.
